SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
MONDAY - MARCH 22, 2021 - 02:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 871 0905 5213
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 10:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 10:00 a.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87109055213
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 871 0905 5213
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD MONDAY,
MARCH 22, 2021, 2:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 871 0905 5213

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 2:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council Member Bruce Barrows
  Council Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo
  Mayor Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to excuse Councilmember
  Grace Hu from the meeting (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES  Barrows, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

4.  Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos City Charter (COUNCIL).

  Staff reports were given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer, and Pam Lee, Interim City
  Attorney. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  Pam Lee, Interim City Attorney noted for the record that at the Monday, March 1, 2021,
  2:00 p.m. City Council Special Meeting conducted for the purpose of reviewing the City
  Charter, staff was directed to review Charter Section 903 Tax Limits (Section 903(a)),
  specifically Section 903(a) with respect to the one percent (1%) tax on property.

  Ms. Lee further noted that the current wording of Section 903(a) authorizes the City
  Council to assess property tax of up to one percent (1%) of assessed value, subject to a
  two-thirds voter approval. However, in 1978, California voters adopted Proposition 13
  which capped any property taxes to 1% of an assessed value, and capped any annual
  tax increases of up to 2% of that assessed value. The adoption of Proposition 13
  rendered Charter Section 903(a) null and void, thereby prohibiting any potential City
  Council property tax action or Cerritos ballot initiative in accordance with the current
  wording of the referenced Charter Section.

  Ms. Lee stated that staff’s recommendation is to delete Charter Section 903(a) from the
  Charter to remove any conflict with Proposition 13. Additionally, further review of
  Section 903(b), (c), and (d) was recommended to ensure the wording is clear and not in
  conflict with State law. This item will be reviewed again at a future Charter Review
  Study Session.

4.  (continued)

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Celia Spitzer submitted written correspondence regarding the proposed new Charter
  Section 609 Nepotism.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to schedule City Council
  Special Meetings for the purpose of additional Charter Review Study Sessions to be held
  on Saturday, April 17, 2021, 2:00 p.m. and Wednesday, April 28, 2021, 2:00 p.m. in
  the City Council Chamber (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES  Barrows, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Mayor Solanki read a statement into the record stating the City’s opposition to hate
  crimes against Asian Americans or any person.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to provide an item on an upcoming City
  Council agenda for review and consideration of adoption of a resolution denouncing hate
  crimes against Asian Americans or any person.

5.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 2:21 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk
